name: Universitat Pompeu Fabra
summary: Public university in central Barcelona; eight bachelor's you can take in English, from International Business Economics to data-science engineering.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10). In Catalonia only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in International Business Economics
programmes.about: Economics and business for an international career, with every course taught in English at UPF's Faculty of Economics and Business in central Barcelona.
programmes.ib: All courses in English; B2 English is essential, but no English test is required for admission.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Global Studies
programmes.about: Cultural, economic, legal, environmental, political and technological change studied across disciplines, with compulsory study of a further language.
programmes.ib: Taught in English in years 1–2; years 3–4 electives run in English, Spanish or Catalan. B2 English advisable.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Technologies and Economic Analysis
programmes.about: Industrial engineering combined with the fundamentals of economics, taught entirely in English jointly by UPF and the Polytechnic University of Catalonia (UPC).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering
programmes.about: A science-based computer engineering degree covering areas such as virtual reality, data science, cybersecurity and machine learning.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Computational Audiovisual Engineering
programmes.about: Designing and developing audio, video and multimedia systems; formerly Audiovisual Systems Engineering, with a largely shared first year across UPF's ICT degrees.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Network Engineering
programmes.about: Designing, managing and operating networks, protocols and multimedia telecom services, with elective tracks in audiovisual systems, software or business.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Mathematical Engineering in Data Science
programmes.about: An engineering profile built on maths and data: analysing large volumes of data from social networks, medicine or smart cities to support decisions.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Double Bachelor's Degree: Bachelor of Laws (KCL) + Bachelor Degree in Law (UPF)
programmes.about: English common law and Spanish law in one double degree: years 1–2 at King's College London, years 3–4 at UPF in Barcelona.
programmes.ib: Apply through UCAS by 13 January 2027, 18:00 UK time, with the LNAT law test; King's IB entry requirements apply.
programmes.selectionNote: Selected through UCAS on your IB record, the LNAT and a teacher's reference with predicted grades; 15 to 30 places.

notes: If you apply through the EU/IB route you may not apply to UPF by any other route in the same academic year.
The Law double degree with King's College London is applied for through UCAS, by 13 January 2027, not through the Catalan pre-enrolment.
Where a degree runs an English and a Catalan/Spanish group, its places and cut-off cover both groups.
